patch.description: Slices 780–783. OpenCode approved the S780 head; Claude requested changes; Codex confirmed the finding. PR #43 remains OPEN/CLEAN/MERGEABLE. GitHub's effective-rules query for main returned [] and classic branch protection returned 404, so no formal approval gate applies. The product owner requires two internal approvals and no outside reviewers. S782 is fixing the first T01 save via a guarded payload-v2 child, with full gates and new reviews of the exact updated PR head. S783 owns normal rebase merge, main CI/deployment, actual preview verification and canonical closeout. Keep this item In Progress until verification and deployment pass.
